intro.title: Explore Queen's Park Savannah
intro.description:
Queen's Park Savannah is the largest open space in Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago. This historic park and recreational area is a popular destination for both locals and tourists, offering beautiful scenery and rich cultural significance.

Located at 11 Queen's Park E, the Savannah is surrounded by notable landmarks and serves as a central hub for recreational activities, cultural events, and community gatherings. With its vast green spaces and convenient location, it has become an iconic symbol of Trinidad and Tobago's capital city.

visitGuide.title: Visiting Tips
items: The park is open daily with free admission
Early morning and late afternoon are the best times to visit
Bring a camera to capture the beautiful scenery

alsoKnownAs.title: Highlights
items: Vast Green Space: The Savannah offers expansive lawns and walking paths, perfect for exercise and relaxation.
Cultural Hub: Host to numerous cultural events, festivals, and celebrations throughout the year.
Historic Significance: Surrounded by heritage sites and colonial-era architecture.
Recreational Activities: Ideal for walking, jogging, cricket, and family outings.

route.title: Tour Route
route.overview: The ideal route to explore Queen's Park Savannah:
steps: Enter the Savannah from Queen's Park East.
Walk along the perimeter and enjoy the scenic views.
Visit the nearby landmarks and cultural sites.
Relax in the green spaces and experience local life.
supplements: Visit during daylight hours for the best experience.
Check for local events and festivals that may be happening.
Respect the park environment and dispose of trash properly.

transport.title: Transportation
transport.airportDesc: From Piarco International Airport, take a taxi or drive to Port of Spain. The Savannah is easily accessible from the city center.
transport.selfDriveDesc: The park is located in central Port of Spain. Use navigation to get there. Parking is available in surrounding areas.
transport.busDesc: You can take public transportation to the Savannah area. It is a well-known landmark in Port of Spain.
transport.intercityDesc: The Savannah is pedestrian-friendly with walking paths around the perimeter.
transport.cyclingDesc: Taxis and maxi-taxis are readily available in Port of Spain.
transport.tipsDesc: Queen's Park Savannah is an excellent place to experience the culture and lifestyle of Trinidad and Tobago. Daytime visits are recommended.

officialManagement.title: About Queen's Park Savannah
officialManagement.text: Queen's Park Savannah is a famous public park in Port of Spain, featuring beautiful green landscapes and rich cultural value. It is managed and maintained by the relevant authorities of Trinidad and Tobago.

historyTimeline.title: Historical Timeline

items.title: Early Period: Park Establishment
items.description: Queen's Park Savannah was established as a public recreational space for the citizens of Port of Spain, and has long been regarded as an important gathering place by locals.

items.title: 20th Century: Facility Improvement
items.description: With the development of Port of Spain, the Savannah gradually improved its facilities, becoming an important place for citizens' leisure and cultural events.

items.title: 21st Century: Cultural Landmark
items.description: Entering the 21st century, with its beautiful environment and convenient location, it has attracted more visitors and become an iconic cultural space in Port of Spain.

historyTimeline.guideContent: When visiting, you can enter the Savannah from Queen's Park East; then walk around the perimeter and enjoy the scenery and leisure atmosphere; if you have enough time, you can relax in the green spaces and experience the local culture. Finally, explore the surrounding areas of Port of Spain and feel the charm of Trinidad and Tobago's capital.
